connector.name: Japan Data MCP by Mameta29
connector.registryDescription: 30 tools for Japanese data: address, furigana, transit, Diet, holidays, weather, corporate registry
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package japan-data-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mameta29 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key of a USDC-funded wallet used to pay per-call x402 fees. Optional: without it the server starts and lists all tools, but paid tool calls return a 'payments disabled' error.
